results.name: All five ordinary seeds draw finite paths and leave collision/trail data untouched
The cached body retains the exact colored circular boundary and puts the almond inside it
The five new body sprites stay below 45 KB and warmed frames make no new surfaces or gradients
Reduced motion keeps the projectile pose static and omits its trail
Loaded and tray seeds reuse a bounded cache even through a regrowth pop
Keepsake and power branches retain distinct illustrations without mutating seeds
Grown seed bodies are cached sprites that stay inside the round hit circle; only the maple wing reaches past it
Grown styles: Animations off draws the seed still with no trail, and every draw leaves the seed and the canvas as it found them
The warm-up paints every grown piece ahead, so the seed, its trail and its bloom make no new surface or gradient in play
From Level 4 every full tray slot gets a tinted disc (r 10) then its glyph, and the cup seed its glyph
Every glyph shape spans exactly 8.5 px top to bottom, and an empty slot or a Level 1-3 board shows none
The glyphs, discs and tray body are cached: a second frame makes no new surface or gradient
